The National Defence Academy (NDA) examination is conducted by UPSC for entry to the Army, Navy and Air Force wings of the NDA. SBPS students can prepare with Doon Baluni Defence Academy, which also covers CDS, NA, SSB, AFCAT, RIMC, Sainik School and RMS entrance preparation.

### How the integrated programme works

It is a whole new game and a new competitive environment for students who pass Xth standard, as it can be a strong or weak foundation for your future, depending on how your advance preparation. So without further ado, Baluni Group offers its 5 & 2-year integrated programme for schooling as well as competitive exam preparations for entrance exams such as JEE Advanced, JEE Mains, and so on. This is another golden opportunity the Best Institute in Dehradun, Baluni, offers for all students.

An Integrated Programme aims to not only cover the intensive syllabus that should be well prepared for before commencing XIth standard, but also other competitive exams after schooling. An integrated program works in line with the school syllabus and also the extra-curriculum, so the students never face any dilemma regarding lagging behind. In its 2-year duration, Baluni Classes helps clear the concepts of Science disciplines, namely Chemistry, Biology, and Physics, for XIth standard, and also the topics you may face in the XIIth standard. Besides, Baluni also provides test series and online/offline mock tests for preparation of other competitive exams. As the best online coaching for NEET in India, we deliver as wellas guarantee the parameters of academic success.
